text:
maya: Quick sync — we need a concise SEV/war-room handoff for the Nimbus marketplace listing next Tue. Goal: one shared comms channel + clear pager path. Who can take lead on the bridge runner role?

owen: I can be bridge runner if no objections. Question: shared channel (cross-org) or a temporary shared Slack with partner?

sophia: prefer shared channel if partner is OK, less context switching. But for HW SI we might need a private shared channel (NDAs).

lia: +1 shared channel for marketplace ops, private for SI. We should document the escalation ladder in the channel header and pin the runbook.

maya: Agreed. I'll ask legal about the SI NDA quick opt-in. For the marketplace partner, @marketplace-int is that fine for visibility?

marketplace-int: marketplace-int: fine on our side. We'll only add engineers for active incidents. One ask: include a direct handoff to our account team before pager escalation.

james: Noted. Proposed routing (short) — put in code block so people can copy:
```
1) partner triage (marketplace-int) — 10m
2) Redwood bridge runner (owen) — 15m
3) Redwood eng-oncall — 15m
4) Redwood infra-sre escalation / exec paging — if >40m
```

tariq: Also add fallback: if shared channel unavailable, fallback to a dedicated warroom call + the oncall pager. Mentioned in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partner-sev-handbook

maya: Good point. We should pin the fallback phone number + meeting link in the channel header.

oncall-bot: deploy: created channel #warroom-nimbus-4850006789 and added oncall rotation hooks.

owen: I'll open the channel now and add the pin contents. Who owns monitoring alerts mapping? sophia?

sophia: I'll own alert mapping. I'll post the alert->pager mapping in the channel and tag thresholds that should be suppressed for first-level triage.

lia: For post-mortem ownership: partner ops (maya) + eng leads (owen/sophia). We'll use the marketplace postmortem template.

marketplace-int: We'll provide our primary liaison (name / pager) before EOD Fri. Also want a brief pre-launch drill Mon 09:30 with bridge runner + SI rep.

maya: Can everyone confirm availability for Mon 09:30? If yes, I'll schedule the drill and add the agenda.

james: I'm in.

owen: In.

sophia: In.

tariq: In.

maya: Great — action items pinned below in the channel when I create it:
- maya: confirm SI NDA opt-in + invite list
- owen: bridge runner + create channel (done)
- sophia: alert->pager mapping + suppression list
- marketplace-int: provide liaison contact
- lia: prepare postmortem template and exec escalation contact

maya: Anything else? Otherwise we'll run the drill Mon and finalize the escalation ladder. :thumbsup:
